column1: Daily Weather Observations for Katherine, Northern Territory for January 2023
Prepared at 13:03 UTC on Thursday 20 July 2023   IDCJDW8024.202301
Most observations from Katherine Country Club, but some from Tindal RAAF base.

Observations were previously taken at the Katherine Aviation Museum; if you require these please contact us. Tindal RAAF base is 13 kilometres away from Katherine Country Club where most of the observation are taken.
Temperature, humidity, cloud, evaporation and rainfall observations are from Katherine Country Club {station 014305}
Wind and pressure observations are from Tindal RAAF {station 014932}
